mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing heavy rain at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 62 degrees under a First Quarter moon.

Starting September 23, the city will begin chip seal road treatments on Cross Country Road and other areas, which will cause some lane closures between 9 AM and 3 PM. Also, the Plan Commission is meeting October 5 to discuss various development projects around the city.

There is plenty to do today, including the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival and the Dane County Farmer's Market. Looking ahead, you can check out Bike the Barns tomorrow at Badger Prairie County Park.
In our weekly police report, on September 3, a 33-year-old man was arrested for an O W I after crashing his vehicle on Shooting Star Road.
The Culver's of Verona is closed for a remodel today, but the team will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
